#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const ll INF = 100000000LL;
ll A[20];
map<pair<int, ll>, ll> memo;

ll dfs(int ind, ll n) {
    if (ind == 0) return n == 0 ? 0 : INF;
    if (n < 0) n = -n;

    auto key = make_pair(ind, n);
    auto it = memo.find(key);
    if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;

    ll m = n / A[ind];
    ll res = min(dfs(ind - 1, n - m * A[ind]) + m * ind,
                 dfs(ind - 1, n - (m + 1) * A[ind]) + (m + 1) * ind);
    memo[key] = res;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    cout << dfs(16, n) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <vector>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const ll INF = 100000000LL;
ll A[20];

struct Frame {
    int ind;
    ll n;
    ll m;
    int stage;
    ll first;
    ll second;
};

ll iterative_dfs(int root_ind, ll start) {
    vector<Frame> st;
    st.push_back({root_ind, start, 0, 0, 0, 0});
    ll result = 0;

    while (!st.empty()) {
        Frame &f = st.back();

        if (f.ind == 0) {
            result = (f.n == 0 ? 0 : INF);
            st.pop_back();
            continue;
        }

        if (f.n < 0) f.n = -f.n;

        if (f.stage == 0) {
            f.m = f.n / A[f.ind];
            ll c1 = f.n - f.m * A[f.ind];
            f.stage = 1;
            st.push_back({f.ind - 1, c1, 0, 0, 0, 0});
        } else if (f.stage == 1) {
            f.first = result;
            f.stage = 2;
            ll c2 = f.n - (f.m + 1) * A[f.ind];
            st.push_back({f.ind - 1, c2, 0, 0, 0, 0});
        } else {
            f.second = result;
            result = min(f.first + f.m * f.ind,
                         f.second + (f.m + 1) * f.ind);
            st.pop_back();
        }
    }

    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    cout << iterative_dfs(16, n) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

const ll INF = 100000000LL;
const ll BIG = (1LL << 62);
ll A[20];

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    if (n < 0) n = -n;

    unordered_map<ll, ll> cur;
    cur[n] = 0;

    for (int i = 16; i >= 1; --i) {
        unordered_map<ll, ll> nxt;

        for (const auto &kv : cur) {
            ll v = kv.first;
            ll base = kv.second;
            ll q = v / A[i];

            ll c1 = v - q * A[i];
            ll cost1 = base + q * i;
            if (i - 1 > 0 && c1 < 0) c1 = -c1;
            auto it = nxt.find(c1);
            if (it == nxt.end()) nxt.emplace(c1, cost1);
            else if (cost1 < it->second) it->second = cost1;

            ll c2 = v - (q + 1) * A[i];
            ll cost2 = base + (q + 1) * i;
            if (i - 1 > 0 && c2 < 0) c2 = -c2;
            it = nxt.find(c2);
            if (it == nxt.end()) nxt.emplace(c2, cost2);
            else if (cost2 < it->second) it->second = cost2;
        }

        cur.swap(nxt);
    }

    ll ans = BIG;
    for (const auto &kv : cur) {
        ll total = kv.second;
        if (kv.first != 0) total += INF;
        if (total < ans) ans = total;
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}

const ll INF = 100000000LL;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    if (n < 0) n = -n;

    map<pair<int, ll>, ll> dist;
    priority_queue<tuple<ll, int, ll>, vector<tuple<ll, int, ll>>, greater<tuple<ll, int, ll>>> pq;

    dist[{16, n}] = 0;
    pq.push({0, 16, n});

    auto relax = [&](int ni, ll nv, ll nd) {
        if (ni > 0 && nv < 0) nv = -nv;
        auto key = make_pair(ni, nv);
        auto it = dist.find(key);
        if (it == dist.end() || nd < it->second) {
            dist[key] = nd;
            pq.push({nd, ni, nv});
        }
    };

    ll answer = BIG;

    while (!pq.empty()) {
        auto [d, idx, val] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        auto key = make_pair(idx, val);
        auto it = dist.find(key);
        if (it == dist.end() || it->second != d) continue;

        if (idx == 0) {
            ll total = d + (val == 0 ? 0 : INF);
            if (total < answer) answer = total;
            continue;
        }

        ll q = val / A[idx];
        relax(idx - 1, val - q * A[idx], d + q * idx);
        relax(idx - 1, val - (q + 1) * A[idx], d + (q + 1) * idx);
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    ll best = BIG;
    int totalMasks = 1 << 16;

    for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; ++mask) {
        ll cur = n;
        ll cost = 0;

        for (int i = 16; i >= 1; --i) {
            if (cur < 0) cur = -cur;

            ll m = cur / A[i];

                cost += (m + 1) * i;
                cur -= (m + 1) * A[i];
            } else {
                cost += m * i;
                cur -= m * A[i];
            }
        }

        ll total = cost;
        if (cur != 0) total += INF;
        if (total < best) best = total;
    }

    cout << best << '\n';
    return 0;
